record.summary: Thesis §4.2, last paragraph: repositories are independent consistency domains, so the hosted server replicates each one in its own Raft group rather than through a shared database tier. This spec adds the control plane to hqgit-server: a ControlPlane seam with a hiqlite-backed implementation and an in-process one for tests; a per-namespace group whose replicated state is the append order of signed entries and the head set, never payload content and never a signature of the cluster's own; a proposal path that validates before forwarding and commits through the leader; an applier that feeds committed entries into the local spec 021 store in order with the payload present first; and consistent-hash placement of groups onto nodes with rebalancing as an operator command. A single node is a one-member group on the same path.
record.title: Per-repo control plane: one Raft group per repository over hiqlite, proposal, apply, placement
